warranty-policy: We guarantee that during the specified warranty period outlined below, products purchased directly from our official website will be free from defects in materials and workmanship under normal use and service. No other warranty, express or implied, is provided for products purchased. Our responsibility for defective products is strictly limited to repair or replacement, as detailed in this Limited Warranty. This warranty does not apply to products purchased from third-party websites such as Amazon or eBay.
The limited warranty applies to all new laser engraving machines purchased from our official website, effective from the date of order fulfillment, as follows:
1-Year Warranty on machine optical components and power-source-related parts.
1-Year Warranty on machine mechanical parts and electrical components (optical lenses are not covered by the warranty).
1-Year Warranty on machine mechanical parts and electrical components.
6-Month Warranty on machine optical power sources.
1-Month Warranty on machine optical lens and reflective mirror.

shipping-policy: Thank you for choosing OneLaser! We aim to ensure a smooth and reliable shipping experience for all of our customers. Please review our shipping policy below for detailed information regarding our shipping rates, delivery times, and limitations.
We offer Fixed Rate Shipping for all orders shipped to the lower 48 states. This rate is designed to provide cost-effective delivery and is calculated based on the size and weight of the shipment.

Fixed Rate Shipping: Unit dimensions, weight, and location are pre-calculated. However, if a larger unit requires a forklift or towing service, these additional costs will not be included in the total shipping cost. Our shipping concierge will confirm this with you, and any additional equipment rental fees will be the customer's responsibility.

Estimated Delivery Time: From the time payment is made, it typically takes a few days to prepare your order for shipment, with an average delivery time between 3–14 business days. Depending on the season, destination, and freight services, additional delays may occur beyond the initial 14 business days.
Shipping to Alaska and Hawaii incurs higher costs due to increased carrier charges. Please note that shipping rates for these regions are not fixed.
Orders to these regions will first be shipped to our warehouse from the manufacturer. We will dispatch them after additional shipping fees are collected.
To get a rough shipping estimate to your location, please contact cs@1laser.com.
Estimated Delivery Time: Typically 14 business days from the time of shipment preparation. Additional delays may occur depending on location and shipping conditions.
We currently do not offer direct shipping to U.S. Territories such as Puerto Rico, Guam, American Samoa, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and other regions outside of the 50 states.

However, if you require shipping to any of these locations, we are happy to assist in arranging third-party shipping. Please contact cs@1laser.com, and our team will help you obtain a quote and coordinate your shipment.

All orders are processed within 3–5 business days after receiving payment. Orders are not dispatched, shipped, or delivered on weekends or holidays. Dispatch typically takes place within 48 hours after the order is processed.
Oversea Purchase Shipping Confirmation and Order Tracking
To ensure a smooth shipping experience and minimize issues during ocean freight:
Our Shipping Concierge will contact you via email before shipment to confirm your address.
Once confirmed, your order will be staged and prepared for shipment.
Once the shipment departs, you’ll receive a follow-up email with tracking information. Please allow 1–2 weeks for full tracking updates.
Delays may occur due to fleet availability or the timing of your confirmation, but we’ll support you every step of the way.
We do not ship to P.O. Boxes or APO/FPO addresses. Due to carrier limitations, certain large or heavy items may have additional shipping restrictions.
To minimize domestic freight time and final-mile delivery costs, we arrange ocean freight shipments to the nearest major port based on your location.

We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to deliver your laser machine efficiently. For updates, please contact cs@1laser.com.
Accessories and warranty replacement parts are shipped via USPS, UPS, or FedEx, depending on size, location, and shipping method selected. Large items may be shipped via LTL (Less-Than-Truckload).
Order Processing: Accessories and warranty parts follow the same 3–5 business day processing time. If an item is out of stock, it will be automatically placed on backorder and shipped once available.
Extended Lead Times: Some components may require longer processing due to sourcing complexity or international delays if not in our domestic warehouse. These are handled case-by-case.

Hydra 13 / Hydra 16 (Large Unit) Delivery & Offloading Policy
Hydra 13 and Hydra 16 machines are industrial-grade systems that unable to perform curbside delivery and require specialized delivery accommodations due to their size and weight.
All deliveries of Hydra 13 and Hydra 16 units require one of the following at the delivery location:
A forklift equipped with extended forks capable of safely unloading the machine from the freight truck
These models are not compatible with standard residential curbside delivery conditions.

If the delivery location has restricted access due to geography, space limitations, carrier constraints, or lack of appropriate unloading equipment, additional services may be required, including but not limited to:
Any additional services arranged to complete delivery are the sole responsibility of the customer. Typical flatbed tow service costs range from $250–$600, depending on location and distance.
Deliveries to rural or remote areas may be subject to additional carrier surcharges and extended service fees. These charges, if applicable, will be billed to the customer.
OneLaser Customer Service will email the customer prior to dispatching the unit to provide offloading instructions and assist with coordinating any necessary special delivery arrangements.
By placing an order for Hydra 13 or Hydra 16, the customer acknowledges and accepts responsibility for meeting all delivery and unloading requirements outlined above.

refund-policy: We are committed to ensuring that our customers are satisfied with their purchases. However, we understand that returns, refunds, and exchanges may sometimes be necessary. This policy outlines the conditions under which returns are accepted, restocking fees are applied, and exchanges are processed.

We take pride in delivering high-quality laser engraving products. If your product is found to be severely damaged and unrepairable upon unboxing or uncrating, we will exchange it for the same model at no cost to you. To ensure a smooth resolution, all issues related to damage or defects must be documented and reported to us immediately upon discovery.

Please note, we cannot accept responsibility for any claims made after 30 days from the date of delivery. If your product arrives damaged or defective, kindly complete our online form and contact our customer service team at cs@1laser.com.

For returns not related to damage or defects, a 25% restocking fee will be applied. The original shipping cost and return shipping expenses are non-refundable. We encourage you to thoroughly inspect your machine upon receipt and report any concerns immediately during the unboxing or uncrating process.

Manufacturer Defects or Unrepairable Damage: Items that negatively affect performance upon delivery are eligible for return under this policy within 30 days of receipt. Defects or damages discovered after delivery are subject to our warranty policy.

Inspection and Restocking Fee Adjustment: Estimated restocking fees are provided at the time of return initiation. However, these fees may be adjusted following a detailed inspection of the returned item to assess its condition.
Non-Returnable Items: Items that have sustained customer-caused damage, modifications, or aftermarket alterations that impair performance are not eligible for return or refund.

Return Shipping: All return shipping costs for refunds or exchanges will be the responsibility of the customer. We will arrange the return label and coordinate the Bill of Lading (BOL) for logistics pick-up. The shipping cost will be deducted from your refund based on the price quote provided under our shipping account.

Price Adjustment Policy: If the price of a OneLaser product drops within 48 hours of your purchase, you can request a refund for the difference (proof of purchase required). Exclusions: Black Friday, Christmas, or other special Federal Holiday promotions, Clearance, and open-box items. We reserve the right to make the final decision based on your request. If eligible, we will process a credit note or refund the difference to your credit card. At OneLaser, we strive to provide the best laser technology at competitive prices, and our Price Adjustment Policy is just one way we demonstrate our commitment to customer satisfaction.
Return Shipping Costs: We are not responsible for the cost of any return shipping materials or additional expenses. Please keep your crates and package material to avoid additional cost.
Third-Party Products: Products sold from other brands, are subject to their own return, refund, and warranty policies.
Final Sale Items: Software and other related services purchases are final and non-refundable.

Leased or Financed Equipment: Returns and refunds cannot be issued for leased or financed equipment due to leasing company terms. However, we can assist and facilitate an exchange with the leasing/finance company if the customer agrees to cover all related cost with the leasing company among with restocking & shipping fees.
What Happens After I Ship the Return?

Once we receive your returned item, we will inspect it and notify you of the return status. If your return is authorized, we will initiate a refund to your original payment method. The credit will be processed according to your payment provider’s policies.
What If I Haven’t Received My Refund Yet?

Refunds may take some time to process. After we receive and inspect the returned product, we will initiate the refund process. If you have not received your refund within two weeks of our receipt of the returned item, please contact our customer support team for assistance.

We only exchange items if they are defective or severely damaged upon delivery. If you need to exchange for the same product, please reach out to us by log into your account and fill out all require field to submit a ticket to our specialist.
If you have any questions regarding how to return your item or need further assistance, please contact our Customer Service team cs@1laser.com
